content:
Nina Park: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. Posting notes and action items.
Ethan Chen: Thanks. Major ask was prioritization: batching vs kernel optimizations?
Nina Park: Short: prioritize batching and caching improvements for immediate p95 wins; parallel kernel refactor continues but lower sprint priority.
Liam O'Connor: For batching, will default batch_time_ms change? any opt-in flag?
Nina Park: Default stays 8ms. New `batch_strategy=adaptive` will be available per-route. Template configs coming to docs.
Sana Gupta: Kernel refactor ETA? impact on quantized models?
Ethan Chen: Kernel tiling work starts in two sprints. Expected benefits: tail p99 improvements and 10-15% token-cost reduction on q8 paths.
ops-bot: Deploy canary `batch-adaptive-v1` started, id c-20260415-09, traffic 3%.
Liam O'Connor: Ops needs rollback criteria spelled out for dashboards.
Nina Park: Rollback triggers: p95 > 2x baseline, error rate delta > 0.5%, eval-regress > 3%. We'll publish alert names and runbook.
Ethan Chen: I'll post perf graphs and canary logs to this thread once we have 20% steady traffic. Thanks everyone.
